name: Problem → solution ("The problem.. → Vs.. → The solution")
status: DEMOTED. 0 for 4 on our pages (HJ 5.6K and 2.7K; Purrventure ×2 at ~3 views). The PROBLEM_CHASE opener went 0/3 ≥50K, median 4.2K (hooks REPORT). One external gadget winner (429K). Do not lead with it on gifts, decor or pets.
summary: A chaos/problem scene with no product, a 'Vs..' card, then the product as the fix. It fails because the first frame shows neither the product nor a recipient, and both are proven requirements.
why: PROBLEM_CHASE opener: 3 HJ reels, none ≥50K, median 4.2K, best 5.6K. It was the only archetype that separated statistically from PALLET (hooks REPORT §1.4).
Two of three Purrventure reels used it; both sat at ~3 views (PLAYBOOK §12).
Exception: tryglowmas 'The problem😬' laser-tag set for boy moms, 429K on IG (external §3d).

shots.content: the problem scene, but the product is visible in frame by 1 s (fixing the measured failure)

measured: HJ 5.6K: a 4.6 s second shot (slow), violating the ≤2.2 s pre-activation rule.
rules: If used at all: product in frame by 1 s, and no shot longer than 2.2 s before activation.

generations.title: Problem scene with product cue
generations.basis: tryglowmas 429K; product-at-0 s fix from hooks REPORT §1.3.
generations.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 iPhone video at a family dinner table: two boys aim toy guns at each other across the plates and mom throws her hands up; the boxed {product} from <<<image_1>>> sits on the counter in the foreground, clearly visible from the first second. Locked camera. Natural sound only: kids yelling, cutlery. No music, no text.
A small American flag is visible in the background.

shot on iphone 12, no warm lighting, no blur, nothing cinematic, make it look as organic as possible, remove the caption and the emojis. when recreating do not make the video grainy or sharp in any way, remake it as if it was freshly refilmed 4k iphone 12 footage.

generations.title: SOLUTION | USE
generations.prompt:
Two shots in one 4-second vertical 9:16 clip joined by a STRAIGHT HARD CUT, no fade, natural real-time speed, handheld phone look, same house, evening. SHOT 1 (0.0-2.0s), framed as the start image: mom hands the boys the {product} from <<<image_1>>>. HARD CUT at 2s, no transition. SHOT 2 (2.0-4.0s), new angle: the boys set it up in the backyard, excited. The {product} from <<<image_1>>> stays identical in colour, shape and details in both shots. Audio: kids cheering. No background music, no text, no captions.
A small American flag is visible in the background.

shot on iphone 12, no warm lighting, no blur, nothing cinematic, make it look as organic as possible, remove the caption and the emojis. when recreating do not make the video grainy or sharp in any way, remake it as if it was freshly refilmed 4k iphone 12 footage.
